title: This Is Why You Cannot Stop Checking Your Phone
hook: Your phone uses a trick that makes slot machines so addictive.

narration.text: Your phone uses a trick that makes slot machines so addictive.
It is called variable ratio reinforcement, a powerful psychological mechanism.
Notifications arrive unpredictably, not every time, and not on a set schedule.
This uncertainty makes us check more often, chasing that unpredictable reward.
Each check is a small gamble, a chance for a new message or update.
The brain loves this pattern, releasing dopamine with every successful hit.
This makes the behaviour incredibly hard to resist, even if you try.
Have you noticed yourself checking your phone without thinking?

description: Ever wonder why it is so hard to stop checking your phone? It is not just you. This video explains the psychology behind those irresistible notification checks, specifically variable ratio reinforcement. It is a powerful mechanism that keeps us engaged and coming back for more.
topic: Why you might find it hard to resist checking your phone for notifications, explaining variable ratio reinforcement.
